name: browser-use
headline: MCP n8n Workflow Builder - AI-Powered Automation
short_description: AI-powered n8n workflow automation through natural language. MCP server enabling Claude AI & Cursor IDE to create, manage, and monitor workflows via Model Context Protocol. Multi-instance support, 17 tools, comprehensive docs. Build workflows conversationally without manual JSON editing.
author: salacoste

sections.overview:
n8n Workflow Builder MCP Server connects Claude AI and Cursor IDE to n8n, allowing you to create and manage workflows through natural language instead of manual JSON editing. The skill provides 17 comprehensive tools covering the complete workflow lifecycle—creation, updates, execution monitoring, and tag management—with built-in support for multiple n8n environments (production, staging, development). Users can describe workflows in plain English and let AI generate production-ready configurations, eliminating context switching between IDE and UI. The MCP server handles secure credential management, supports both Claude Desktop and Cursor IDE, and includes multi-instance routing for seamless environment management.
Create webhook workflows with validation and notifications by describing requirements in natural language
Manage multiple n8n environments (dev, staging, production) from a single IDE without switching contexts
Monitor and retry workflow executions while staying in Claude AI or Cursor
Organize workflows with tags and manage credentials securely across instances
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/salacoste/mcp-n8n-workflow-builder`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
